mechanics.claim: Entering the shroud renders Akali invisible unless she is dashing.
mechanics.quote: Entering the shroud renders '''Akali''' {{tip|invisibility|invisible}}, unless she is {{tip|dash|dashing}}.

mechanics.claim: A basic attack or ability cast breaks the invisibility and starts a cooldown before Akali can re-enter it, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.
mechanics.quote: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent '''Akali''' from entering it again for ... seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.

mechanics.claim: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup, not on-hit.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: The shroud does not permeate terrain and expands toward nearby enemy champions.
mechanics.quote: The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions.

mechanics.claim: Twilight Shroud's effects (energy restore, movement speed, smoke bomb) begin at the start of the cast time, and Akali can move during the cast time.
mechanics.quote: ''Twilight Shroud's'' effects begin at the start of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the ability's effect (post-effect), not on cast.
